name: Cursed Idol of Tsathogga (Minor Artifact)
body:
Aura Strong enchantment; CL 20th; Slot none; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This squat, hideous idol is carved from an alien stone and appears to be a bloated cross between frog, monkey, and bat. The creature’s eyes are a pair of glittering rubies which seem to glow with an unholy light. Beings caught within the presence of the idol must make a DC 20 Will save or become fascinated by the fetish (CL 20th). While fascinated, their minds are opened to the raw chaos of the Frog God. Creatures thus fascinated think of nothing other than the idol, defending it, and doing its will, which is in essence a direct communicator to the unholy bidding of Tsathogga!

Such cursed beings are allowed a new save each day, though the save DC increases by one each day.

The oppression of their psyche leads sentient creatures to thoughts of anguish, suicide, and murder until they have completely succumbed to the power of the bizarre, batrachian god. The idol commands beings to commit acts of chaos and murder, even if such actions are against the alignment of the fascinated being, though for each horrid act, the being is granted an additional Will save at that days DC, with a +2 morale bonus to their save.

Fascinated beings begin to suffer physically from the toll that the cursed idol after their first day of control.

These beings must make a successful DC 20 Fortitude save or begin to mutate into a tsathar The mutation process takes 1d6 days, allowing an additional save each day to halt the process; however the DC escalates by +1 for each day that the save is failed. If the save is successful, no further tsathar mutation takes place for that day. If the save is successful two consecutive days, the victim has fought off the mutation. The victim transforms back to humanity in one additional day (regardless of how far the mutation progressed).

The idol has no effect when within an area under the effects of a hallow spell. The fascinate effect can be broken with a successful break enchantments spell against DC 25.

For those who can avoid the curses and pitfalls of the Idol of Tsathogga, there are a number of unique powers that can be brought to bear against foes of the Frog God.

Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th): Constant—unhallow (the unhallow adds a doom effect which causes enemies of the Frog God within a 40 ft. radius of the idol to suffer a –2 to saves vs. fear effects).

1/round—cause fear, jump, stinking cloud
1/day—lesser globe of invulnerability, nightmare,summon swarm (this summons a swarm of poisonous frogs, or bats 1/week—summon (level 7, 1 hezrou demon)

DESTRUCTION

This relic may be destroyed by being fed to Tsathogga himself; or given over as food to some other equally malevolent deity, arch fiend, or demon lord; or if the Idol is struck by the blessed weapon of a god of Law and Good.
